summary: The Laken Riley Act requires DHS to detain inadmissible noncitizens charged with or convicted of theft, burglary, shoplifting, assault on law enforcement, or crimes causing death or serious injury, issue detainers to take them into custody, and allows state attorneys general to sue in federal court to enforce these and other detention rules.

scores.thoughts: The bill mandates expanded detention of certain noncitizens by DHS, which would require additional resources for custody and enforcement. This has a minor but direct implication for increasing federal spending on immigration enforcement operations.
The bill contains no provisions related to taxes, tax rates, or revenue collection.
The bill contains no provisions related to healthcare policy, coverage, or markets.
The bill contains no provisions related to firearms regulation or gun rights.

The core purpose of the bill is to expand mandatory detention of noncitizens charged with theft and related offenses, strengthen enforcement mechanisms, and empower state attorneys general to sue for stricter application of detention and removal rules. This directly advances border enforcement and restriction of immigration pathways.
The bill contains no provisions related to abortion access or restrictions.
The bill contains no provisions related to military or defense spending.
The bill contains no provisions related to environmental regulations or climate policy.
The bill contains no provisions related to welfare programs or social safety net benefits.
The bill contains no provisions related to education policy or school funding.
The bill contains no provisions related to drug enforcement or decriminalization.

While the bill focuses on immigration detention, it expands mandatory custody for noncitizens charged with theft, burglary, assault on law enforcement, and similar offenses, reinforcing stricter enforcement and removal rather than rehabilitation-focused approaches.
The bill contains no provisions related to trade, tariffs, or globalization.
The bill contains no provisions that directly address deficits, debt reduction, or fiscal policy.
The bill contains no provisions related to LGBTQ+ legal protections.
The bill contains no provisions related to foreign aid.
The bill contains no provisions related to voting access or election procedures.
The bill contains no provisions related to technology regulation or data privacy.
The bill contains no provisions related to labor unions or worker protections.
The bill contains no provisions related to religious exemptions or anti-discrimination laws.
